_comment: source (UI choice) -> CM360 Site + placement naming convention. adKey decides how an Ad is named from a parsed zip unit. Extensible; refine with training pairs. Facebook/DemGen conventions are first-guess.
_fileFormats: Optional per-source block deciding what the FILE FORMAT of a delivery (GIF/PNG/JPG/HTML) does to the structure. mode: 'ignore' = format plays no part (ads named by dimension alone); 'adSuffix' = one placement, ad named {dimension}_{format} (160x600_gif); 'placement' = one placement per format, named via `placements`, each holding only the dimensions from its own folder. `aliases` folds interchangeable names together. The format is read from the WORDS of the top-level folder ('SPÓŁKA JPG', 'HTML FRC') because PNG and JPG both parse as asset type 'image' and cannot be told apart from the type alone.
